summary.diagnosis:
*Oct 7→Oct 13 vs Sep 30→Oct 6* · Revenue -10% (1,108,321 vs 1,233,516 EGP) · Spend +7% · ROAS 4.93 (-16%).
   • CPC: 2.29 → 2.51 EGP (+10%, up (drag))
   • CVR: 1.1% → 1.06% (-4%, ~flat)
   • AOV: 1,230 → 1,167 EGP (-5%, down (drag))
   *Who moved it:* *CPC 51%* of the move (hurt, -19,693 EGP)  ·  *AOV 29%* of the move (hurt, -59,850 EGP)  ·  *CVR 20%* of the move (hurt, -41,786 EGP).
   *Read:* *CPC* rose +10%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *-19,693 EGP of spend*.
     That drove ROAS -16%.
     Revenue -10% because spend +7%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *costumes - lblb layout*, its CPC went 1.54 EGP→2.25 EGP on 6,904 EGP spend (~11% of the swing).
